prompt: Wide shot from deep inside a small British corner shop at night, looking toward the front: the inside of the big shop window, its display ledge running along the bottom of the glass, cluttered with sun-faded empty dummy boxes and a dead pot plant. In the middle of the ledge, small in the frame and lit by a single clip-on lamp, sit a loaf of plain white sliced bread in a clear plastic bag and a small chocolate bar in a plain purple foil wrapper with no logo and no writing. Through the rain-beaded window: the wet terraced street, parked cars, one orange streetlamp burning. In the foreground, out of focus, the end of a shelf unit and a wire basket. Propped against the loaf is a white card price sign, big handwritten black marker letters reading exactly "£50". Propped against the chocolate bar is a smaller white card, big handwritten black marker letters: "10p" crossed out with one hard black line, and beside it "£12". Outside, the orange streetlamp has gone dark. Candid snapshot on cheap 400-speed colour negative film at night, pushed: heavy visible grain, slightly soft focus, muddy blacks, sickly teal-green cast from old fluorescent tubes, faint warm sodium orange from the street. Vertical 9:16. Nobody in the shop, no people, no hands, no shadows of people. No brand names or logos anywhere; every packet in the background is blurred and unreadable. Thanks.
